purpose: Section 2.1 defines the margin from the frequency-dependent loop response. Section 2.2 must explain how evolving experimental signals yield the averaged spectra used by Section 2.3. Present the window settings and transforms first, then spectral smoothing and the monitored frequencies, and finish with the operating-condition notation.
first_draft: The loop response required by the margin in {eq:bncf} changes as the specimen degrades. The estimator therefore analyses short windows of the reference $u$ and measured displacement $y$ during the experiment. Each estimate is updated every $\Delta t=0.125\,\mathrm{s}$ using the most recent $T_w=0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ of data. Consecutive windows therefore overlap by 75%. At $f_s=2048\,\mathrm{Hz}$, each window contains $N=f_sT_w=1024$ samples and has a frequency-bin spacing of 2 Hz.
